postcheck.description: verify FK "session_userId_fkey" exists with the planned columns, referenced table and actions
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3) AND "c"."contype" = $4 AND (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(key_attribute.attname ORDER BY key_column.position), '[]'::jsonb) FROM unnest("c"."conkey"::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS key_column(attnum, position) JOIN pg_attribute key_attribute ON key_attribute.attrelid = "c"."conrelid" AND key_attribute.attnum = key_column.attnum) = ($5)::jsonb AND "c"."confrelid" = to_regclass($6) AND (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(key_attribute.attname ORDER BY key_column.position), '[]'::jsonb) FROM unnest("c"."confkey"::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS key_column(attnum, position) JOIN pg_attribute key_attribute ON key_attribute.attrelid = "c"."confrelid" AND key_attribute.attnum = key_column.attnum) = ($7)::jsonb AND "c"."confdeltype" = $8 AND "c"."confupdtype" = $9)) AS "result"
